instructions:
1. Lie face down on the machine with your ankles under the leg pads and legs fully extended.
2. Hold the side handles to keep your torso stable.
3. Curl both legs by bending your knees, pulling your ankles toward your glutes.
4. Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement.
5. Lower your legs back to full extension under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips pressed into the pad throughout the movement.
2. Curl through a full range without swinging.
3. Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower.
4. Control the lowering phase to keep tension on the hamstrings.
name: HAMMER STRENGTH ISO-LATERAL LEG CURL_Both Leg

instructions:
1. Sit on the machine with your feet flat and the seat set so your upper arms rest on the pad.
2. Grasp both handles with palms facing up.
3. Curl both handles by bending your elbows, bringing your hands toward your shoulders.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
5. Lower the handles back to full extension under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms pressed into the pad throughout.
2. Hold a neutral wrist to keep load on the biceps.
3. Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower.
4. Use a full range and avoid jerking the weight.
name: Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Biceps Curl Both Arm

instructions:
1. Sit on the machine with your feet flat and your upper arms resting on the pad.
2. Grasp one handle with the palm facing up.
3. Curl that handle by bending your elbow, bringing your hand toward your shoulder.
4. Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower under control.
5. Finish your reps on one arm, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the working upper arm pressed into the pad.
2. Hold a neutral wrist to keep load on the biceps.
3. Exhale as you curl, inhale as you lower.
4. Avoid leaning toward the working arm.
name: Hammer Strength MTS Iso-Lateral Biceps Curl Single Arm

instructions:
1. Sit with your back against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
2. Grasp one handle with palm facing down.
3. Press that handle forward by extending your arm, keeping the other arm still.
4. Squeeze your chest at full extension, then return under control.
5. Finish your reps on one arm, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back and the working shoulder pressed into the pad.
2. Brace your core to resist twisting toward the working arm.
3. Exhale as you press, inhale as you return.
4. Press in a smooth line without shrugging.
name: HAMMER STRENGTH MTS ISO-LATERAL DECLINE PRESS Single Arm

instructions:
1. Sit on the machine with your chest pressed against the pad and feet flat.
2. Grasp the handles with palms facing forward.
3. Pull one handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back and squeezing the shoulder blade.
4. Hold briefly, then return that handle under control.
5. Repeat on the other arm, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest against the pad and torso upright.
2. Lead with the elbow to engage the back, not the arms.
3. Squeeze the shoulder blade at the end of each pull.
4. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you return.
name: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Alternate Arms
